aws_service: Amazon CloudWatch / Amazon GuardDuty / Amazon Bedrock AgentCore / AWS Security Hub CSPM
guidance: Distributed tracing tells you what happened on one request. Coordination monitoring tells you when many requests start behaving differently from the baseline. Tracking inter-agent message rates, workflow frequencies, and topology changes against established baselines catches issues through their observable impact on coordination before they escalate into security events.
how_to_check: • You detect anomalous coordination patterns such as unexpected agent communication paths, unusual interaction frequencies, or coordination latency spikes in near real time and trigger alerts for investigation. • You establish baseline coordination profiles for each agent workflow, so statistical anomaly detection catches deviations before they cause significant impact. For more information, see the AGENTSEC06-BP04 documentation.
